name: Buffalo Inc.
summary: Buffalo Inc., through its subsidiaries, develops, manufactures, and sells digital home appliances and computer peripherals in Japan, North America/Central America, Europe, and Asia. The company offers Wi-Fi, Wired LAN, Hard Disk/ NAS, SSD, Blu-ray/DVD/CD drive, memory, USB memory, memory cards reader/writer, video/audio equipment, cable, mouse, keyboard and input devices, web camera and headset, smartphone accessories, tablet accessories, power supply related products, accessories and storage, tv accessories, and other peripherals.
